data: Which of the following datasets are shown in Figure 6?

The caption states that the figure shows smoothed precision-recall curves for models with BiLM pretraining and no pretraining. The question asks which datasets are shown in Figure 6. From the caption, we know that the figure contains two subfigures labeled (a) NCBI-disease dataset and (b) BC5CDR dataset. Therefore, the datasets shown in Figure 6 are the NCBI-disease dataset and the BC5CDR dataset.
